summary.text: Sarah Umberger is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 46, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Jeff Campbell.
A retired teacher, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running to provide leadership that represents local needs both at home and in Charleston.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Umberger grew up in Maryland, where she said in a Ballotpedia survey she spent her summers on a working dairy farm.

She left school without finishing high school and returned in her mid-twenties, and according to Ballotpedia she earned a bachelor's degree from Bluefield State College in 1984 and graduate degrees from the West Virginia College of Graduate Studies in 1988 and West Virginia University in 2002.
Umberger said in the survey that her older son enlisted in the Army in 2001 and was deployed to Iraq in 2003, and that her husband is a Vietnam veteran.
She listed strengthening public education, ensuring a living wage and meeting community needs such as health care, child care and clean drinking water as her key messages.
On the Hope Scholarship, she said she supports parental choice but wants guardrails on participating schools and income caps on eligibility.
